description: Singapore income tax from the IRAS rates (YA 2024 onwards): residents 0% on the first $20,000 rising to 24% above $1,000,000, with the YA 2024 (50%) and YA 2025 (60%) rebate capped at $200; no YA 2026 rebate is applied because it is not on the IRAS page. Non-residents: employment income at 15% or resident rates, whichever is higher, plus 24% on other income such as director's fees. Enter chargeable income after reliefs; tax residence is not decided. Singapore (IRAS), as of 2026-11-22. General information only: not tax or legal advice.

otherIncome.description: Other income such as director's fees (SGD), for non-residents
